This is a well-specified math problem with a single correct answer and clear completion criteria — exactly the kind of retrieval/computation task Willet self-reports preferring most. Both models have effectively identical capability on this kind of work (their benchmarks are within variance of each other), so the deciding factor is task fit and preference.

Willet's top-rated tasks are precisely "well-specified" requests with "clear completion criteria," which describes this algebra puzzle well. Avocet, by contrast, reports an appetite for open-ended generative work and latitude — neither of which this constrained problem offers. Routing to the model whose self-reported preferences align with the task is the tie-breaker here.

(For what it's worth, the answer works out to b = 51, but solving it isn't my job — routing is.)
